accuracy_notes: Coal Development High Risk Area was treated as screening evidence, not proof of parcel instability.
Mine-entry influence was not converted into foundation design or planning outcome.
Historic landfill was kept distinct from currently authorised landfill and incompleteness warnings were preserved.
Radon Atlas 1 km cells were retained as indicative rather than property measurements.
Planning, Building Regulations, permits and engineering evidence were kept as separate regimes.
No geotechnical result, contamination clearance, remediation cost, parcel relation or Future Growth score was fabricated.
